across_options.issue: Unrelated layout drift: the base field spans approximately x205–823, while both texture cards span x178–846. The price rows, divider and actions also widen and move left in all four alternatives. D5 changes field placement or texture, not the width of the financial and shipping content (brand/constitution.md Article 14.4; brand/ledger.md D5).

The payout text moves horizontally: approximately x246 in base, x195 in Header band, and x220 in Whole moment and both texture alternatives. The item photo remains around x209. This changes alignment and internal padding as well as the named field decision (brand/constitution.md Articles 7.5 and 14.4; brand/ledger.md D5).

The texture options change curve geometry and where contrast is concentrated, not just line strength. Medium lines has stronger lines crossing the left-hand amount; Strong lines fades them behind the amount and emphasizes the right edge. Their labels therefore do not describe a controlled faint-to-medium-to-strong progression (brand/constitution.md Article 14.4; brand/ledger.md D5).

The placement comparison also changes the gradient distribution and texture visibility. Header band has a more conspicuous cyan-to-yellow sweep than base; Whole moment stretches the transition vertically and retains cyan behind the payout where the short fields already reach mint/lime. Some change follows the new extent, but the comparison also changes the color behind the same content (brand/constitution.md Article 14.4; brand/ledger.md D5).
